features.description: Add a production caller for the pre-impl sufficiency audit and make plan lock generate the findings when a gated plan is missing them, instead of dead-ending on a required-but-ungenerated artifact.
features.acceptance: a production entry drives the resolved cross-vendor auditor through the registered executor and persists sufficiency-findings.json; dontpanic plan lock invokes it for a gated goal_type when findings are absent, and degrades with an actionable message (not a dead-end) when no auditor is configured; verified by a test that runs the audit with an injected dispatch and asserts the artifact is written.

evidence_refs.note: Fix merged to main via PR #31 (the three pre-impl governance defects).
Merged PR carrying the fix; independently paid Codex-audited per D005 (needs_changes -> fixed-forward).

features.description: Stop the pre-lock design-review volley from crashing when a feature carries an enum field, by serializing feature dicts to JSON-safe values.
features.acceptance: the design volley serializes feature dicts with enum values coerced to strings so the JSON serializer never raises the 'Object of type Category is not JSON serializable' error; a test asserts the real plan's feature dicts are JSON-serializable via the json-mode serialization and that the plain dump would have raised.

features.description: Make the pre-impl sufficiency parser reuse the known-good post-impl Codex JSONL parser plus tolerant JSON coercion, so a Codex stream or a JSON value with trailing prose parses instead of being discarded; add a no-paid fixture replaying the wasted response and an end-to-end dry-run.
features.acceptance: the Codex streaming extractor lives in a shared module reused by both audit boundaries (single source of truth, no circular import); the sufficiency parser pulls the assistant-message payload from a Codex stream and tolerates a valid JSON value followed by trailing prose; a no-paid fixture replays the wasted-response shape into the sufficiency parser and gets findings, and an end-to-end dry-run runs draft → sufficiency audit → gate-sees-findings → design-volley-serializes without crashing.
